FRIDAY EVENING ARRIVAL (Friday) - Action: Arrive early Friday evening. - Where: Choose a city or region that fits your interests. Since you love museums and historic neighborhoods, consider: - Boston ( museums, historic Boston Common, and quiet cafes) - Philadelphia (art museums, historic Philadelphia, and easy walking) - Washington, DC (National museums, monuments, and laid-back eateries) - San Francisco (Golden Gate Park museums, historic neighborhoods like Mission District, and vegetarian-friendly food) greater than Pro tip: All these cities have excellent public transit and walkable historic districts perfect for a relaxed weekend. Saturday: MUSEUMS, WALKS, and LOCAL EATING (Full Day) - Morning: Start with a morning museum visit. Choose one that is not too large or crowded. - Boston: Museum of Fine Arts (MFA) or Boston Children's Museum (less crowded, still engaging) - Philadelphia: Philadelphia Museum of Art (PMA) or The Barnes Foundation - Washington, DC: National Museum of Asian Art or National Air and Space Museum (NASM) greater than Why not the National History Museum? it is huge and often packed. Stick to smaller, more intimate spaces. - Afternoon: Easy walk to a historic neighborhood.
